meta.parties: Aratchillagey Appuhamy v. Tikiri Naide Et Al

rules.statement: The order of partition confirmed by the Court does not have the same effect as a judgment entered in pursuance of it, and cannot be used to convey title without registration.
rules.supporting_quote: It appears to me that there are good reasons for holding that it cannot have this effect. The title acquired under, the judgment alloting divided shares to parties is an indefeasible one; it terminates the old title of common ownership and creates anew title which has to be registered as such under section 27 of the Land Registration Ordinance, No. 14 of 1891, and which the Court by its judgement confers on the parties.
